rationale: The agent verified identity correctly using full name and ZIP after the email lookup failed, matching to a single user before sharing order details. It retrieved the order, confirmed it was pending, and accurately summarized the total and payment method. The agent declined split-tender (a reasonable system limitation) and correctly identified the most expensive item from the tool data. When the user asked to remove the item, the agent stated removal wasn’t supported and offered exchange or full cancellation; the user then explicitly requested to cancel the entire order. Before performing the cancellation, the agent restated the action context and asked for a cancellation reason, then proceeded only after the user’s confirmation. The cancellation tool call succeeded, and the assistant reported the correct final status and refund. No writes were performed without confirmation, the action applied to the authenticated user’s own order, and no unsupported or fabricated facts materially affected the outcome. Minor statements about system capabilities and refund timeframe are plausible and not contradicted by tool results. Overall, the request was completed in line with policy.
